description: Defines the internal structure and functions for managing an X11 window, including graphics compositing and video frame handling, for the Starboard platform.

classes.name: SbWindowPrivate
classes.description: Internal structure representing a private window with graphics and video compositing capabilities, including members for X11 resources, display, size, and resize state.

methods.name: SbWindowPrivate
methods.description: Constructor initializing the window with display and options.

methods.name: ~SbWindowPrivate
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up window resources.

methods.name: BeginComposite
methods.description: Prepares the window for compositing graphics and video frames.

methods.name: CompositeVideoFrame
methods.description: Composites a video frame onto the window within specified bounds.
